name_input: H L L LIFECARE LTD (FORMERY-HINDUSTAN LATEX LTD)
product_summary: HLL Lifecare Limited (ex-Hindustan Latex Ltd), Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala — Mini Ratna CPSE under Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (source: lifecarehll.com home page; hllestore.in footer). Real product lines published on own e-store (hllestore.in/collections/all, 46 SKUs, product-type filter): (1) male latex condoms — MOODS brand incl. flavoured (Bubblegum, Chocolate, Grapes, Lime, Strawberry), Dotted, Ribbed, Ultrathin, All Night (4% benzocaine lubricant), Silver series, Xtasy series, Graphene condom, Variety Pack → HS 4014.10; (2) female condom 'Velvet' → 4014.10 (or 3926.90 if polyurethane); (3) water-based personal lubricant MOODS Lube → 3304.99/3307.90; (4) surgical sutures — Hidox (polydioxanone), Hilon (polyamide), Hinbond (braided polyester), Hinglact / Hinlact rapid (polyglactin 910), Hinocryl (poliglecaprone 25), Hinsurg (polypropylene), Hisil (braided silk) → 3006.10 (sterile surgical catgut/suture material); (5) blood bags — Haemopack, Donato (single to penta bags, LD filter) → 3923.29 / 9018.39; (6) hormonal IUS 'Emily M-shaped' → 3004.39/3004.49 (contraceptive hormones); (7) non-steroidal contraceptive pill → 3004.60; (8) sanitary napkins 'Happy Days' → 9619.00; (9) menstrual cup 'Velvet' → 3926.90; (10) topical analgesic Diclopro Gel (diclofenac diethylamine) → 3004.90; (11) lactation tonic Lactohil → 2106.90/3004.90; (12) wound-care items (Hidox/Hilon dressings range) → 3005.90; (13) sanitary napkin vending machines and incinerators 'Vendigo' → 8479.89 / 8417.80; (14) millet nutrition bars → 1904.90/2106.90; (15) services: HINDLABS diagnostic centres, 239 retail pharmacies, medical imaging, mental-wellness clinics (services, no HS).
comment: Declared HS 300450 = 'other medicaments containing vitamins/provitamins' (Ch.30 heading 3004.50). This is NOT corroborated by any product line on the company's own catalogue: HLL's core business is latex contraceptives (4014.10), sterile surgical sutures (3006.10), blood bags (3923.29/9018.39), sanitary napkins (9619.00) and hormonal contraceptives (3004.39/3004.49). Only a small slice of the range (Diclopro Gel, Lactohil, contraceptive pills) falls in Ch.30 at all, and none of it is a vitamin preparation. Status: wrong — the declared code does not describe the actual product mix; the company is retained and the code must be corrected to the real export lines (primary: 4014.10 condoms, 3006.10 sutures, 3923.29/9018.39 blood bags, 9619.00 sanitary napkins, 3004.39/3004.49 hormonal contraceptives). Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a clear misclassification: HLL is a public-sector healthcare/contraceptive manufacturer (Ministry of Health & Family Welfare CPSE) — correct industry is pharma/medical devices/rubber-latex consumer health. Trader signs: none — own manufacturing plants listed on site ('Manufacturing Plants' menu), own brands (MOODS, Velvet, Emily, Haemopack, Donato, Hidox/Hilon/Hinbond suture family), so manufacturer role. Product lines missing from the declaration: condoms/female condoms, sutures, blood bags, sanitary napkins, menstrual cup, IUD/IUS, vending/incineration machines, nutrition bars, and the whole diagnostics/pharmacy services arm. All of the above is taken from the company's own website and e-store catalogue only — no customs line, shipping bill or B-L was consulted in this HS-only review, therefore every product-to-HS mapping here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the HS correction is based on the published catalogue, not on a verified customs record. No registry, revenue or volume data researched per scope.
